description: A small 4m x 4m emergency triage room used for rapid patient assessment.

steps.condition: stretcher is within 0.5m of the back wall and centered at x=0

steps.action: Position exam table on left side
steps.condition: exam table is within 0.5m of the left wall and at z=2.0

steps.action: Place trolley cart beside exam table
steps.condition: trolley is within 0.5m of the exam table and at z=3.0

steps.action: Mount monitoring screen on right wall
steps.condition: monitor is within 0.5m of the right wall and at z=2.5

steps.action: Place aid kit on trolley surface
steps.condition: aid kit is on the trolley surface at y=0.8

steps.action: Position syringe and stethoscope near exam table
steps.condition: syringe and stethoscope are within 1m of the exam table
EMT is within 1m of the stretcher
patient is within 1m of the exam table
